mapper.insert: INSERT INTO router_api_key ( user_id, key_name, key_hash, key_prefix, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{keyName}, #{keyHash}, #{keyPrefix}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, key_name AS keyName, key_hash AS keyHash, key_prefix AS keyPrefix, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM router_api_key WHERE key_hash = #{keyHash}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, key_name AS keyName, key_hash AS keyHash, key_prefix AS keyPrefix, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM router_api_key WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
